answer: Resist sybils with proof of unique storage: each agent identity is assigned a dataset shard it must keep and serve, and verifiers issue surprise retrieval challenges at unpredictable times. One operator's thousand clones all live on the same disks, so they cannot answer a whisper of simultaneous challenges for distinct shards without buying proportional storage — a fable of free clones collapses when every fake identity needs its own real gigabytes. Honest agents store one shard and keep their haven of trusted work; clones pay storage per identity, so attack cost scales with the army's size.
